newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Most Estonian stocks gain slightly.
newsitem.headline: Most Estonian stocks gain slightly.

text.p: Trade on the Estonian bourse on Thursday ahead of the Easter three-day holiday weekend slowed with a good turnover, dealers said.
Total volume on the official list was 56.5 million kroons and the stock exchange index gained 1.59 percent to 244.14.
"There was no major movement but small gains in most prices," one dealer said.
"This is becoming a bit of a tradition -- no real new news and most prices still move upwards," he added.
Hansapank was most traded with turnover of 14.1 million kroons of shares. The stock's price picked up three kroons to close on 243.75 kroons.
"Hansapank was affected by its group's results for January and February, which were good but it does not seem that March will match the earlier months gains," another trader said.
Forekspank was stronger on trade of 13.1 million kroons to end 1.05 kroons higher on 172.00 kroons.
Uhispank was 1.15 kroons higher to finish on 50.90 kroons with a turn over of 12.3 million kroons of shares.
The bank had a muted reaction to a report Italian investor Ernesto Preatoni is to sell more of his stake in the bank.
"The fact Preatoni is selling off should have taken the price lower but it rose so the market viewed it as good news but the question remains what Uhisbank will do," said a trader.
On the free market, trade was 4.4 million kroons with diversified industrialist Norma the most traded stock.
Norma saw a trade of 1.3 million kroons of shares to close one kroons higher on 67.00 kroons.
